title: 和歌山県「吉備真備漂着之地」
edition: 和歌山県ウェブサイト (県土整備部道路局道路政策課), read 2026-09-24
author: 和歌山県

license.attribution_text: 和歌山県「吉備真備漂着之地」
license.notes: Government website page. Citation only: the chapter records that the page reports the identification and does not reproduce its text.

notes: The page states that 吉備真備 drifted to 紀伊国牟漏崎 on his return, that 紀州藩's 紀伊続風土記 considered 牟漏崎 to be 太地の燈明崎, and that the place is marked as 吉備真備漂着之地. It reports a modern identification (比定), not a source statement of the eighth century.
